records.title: SatoshiDICE launches on Bitcoin
records.summary: SatoshiDICE was announced on BitcoinTalk and rapidly became one of Bitcoin's largest sources of on-chain transactions.
records.significance: It demonstrated borderless blockchain gambling, provable fairness and one of the first debates about application-generated transaction spam.

records.title: Coinbase is founded
records.summary: Coinbase says it was founded in June 2012.
records.significance: Coinbase became one of the most consequential regulated crypto on-ramps and later the first major US crypto exchange to list publicly.

records.title: XRP Ledger launches
records.summary: The XRP Ledger first launched in June 2012 after development by David Schwartz, Jed McCaleb and Arthur Britto.
records.significance: XRPL was an early major alternative to proof-of-work cryptocurrencies and focused on fast payments and settlement.

records.title: Bitcoin Savings & Trust collapses
records.summary: Bitcoin Savings & Trust stopped operating after a scheme the SEC later proved had offered Bitcoin-denominated investments from February 2011 through August 2012.
records.significance: Its collapse led to the first major Bitcoin-denominated Ponzi securities case in US enforcement history.

sources.title: SEC — Bitcoin Savings and Trust case

records.title: ASICMINER announces an investor-backed Bitcoin ASIC project
records.summary: ASICMINER publicly announced an effort to design and operate application-specific Bitcoin mining chips.
records.significance: It was one of the earliest visible attempts to industrialize purpose-built Bitcoin mining silicon.

records.title: Peercoin blockchain starts
records.summary: Peercoin's blockchain started on 19 August 2012 using a hybrid proof-of-work/proof-of-stake design.
records.significance: Peercoin was an early major proof-of-stake experiment and influenced later alternatives to proof-of-work consensus.

records.title: Bitcoin Foundation is launched
records.summary: Gavin Andresen publicly announced the Bitcoin Foundation on 27 September 2012.
records.significance: It was an early attempt to fund development and promote Bitcoin through an organized nonprofit institution.

records.title: First Bitcoin halving
records.summary: At block 210,000, Bitcoin's block subsidy fell from 50 BTC to 25 BTC.
records.significance: The first halving proved Bitcoin's programmed monetary schedule would execute in practice and created the four-year ritual that became central to Bitcoin culture and mining economics.

records.title: Bitcoinica suffers repeated security failures and collapses
records.summary: Leveraged trading platform Bitcoinica suffered multiple 2012 breaches; a May compromise alone lost 18,547 BTC after production servers were penetrated.
records.significance: Bitcoinica became an early warning about exchange leverage, hot-wallet security and counterparty risk.
